title: Limit Occurrences in Sorted Array
summary: From a nondecreasing array, retain at most k occurrences of each value while preserving order. A value occurring fewer than k times keeps all copies; otherwise keep exactly k. Return the resulting array. An optional follow-up asks for in-place processing with constant auxiliary space, excluding result storage/resizing.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
